backend/main.mo: Backend canister handling user profiles with access control and storing contact form submissions with admin retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting metadata updates for the production domain and associated files/components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining light and dark OKLCH color themes and global style tokens.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, canonical and Open Graph URLs, favicon, and Google Fonts setup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Initializes TanStack Router with all routes and wraps the app in ThemeProvider and SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/contact/InquiryF: Validated contact inquiry form using react-hook-form and mutation hook to submit data to the backend.
frontend/src/components/gallery/GalleryG: Responsive grid displaying gallery images with hover zoom and click-to-open behavior.
frontend/src/components/gallery/GalleryL: Modal lightbox supporting keyboard navigation, next/previous controls, close button, and image counter.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: Site footer with branding, quick links, contact info, social icons, and Caffeine.ai attribution.
Provides a page layout with top navigation, main content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/site/TopNav.tsx: Implements a responsive navigation bar with desktop links and mobile sheet menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity context handling login, stored identity loading, and auth-client setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a mutation hook for submitting contact inquiries via the backend actor and invalidates contact queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with company story and feature highlights using styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact information and embeds an inquiry form with styled cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Renders a gallery page with image grid and lightbox navigation using local state for selected image.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Defines the homepage with a hero section, feature cards, and navigation buttons for key site areas.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Displays pricing info with a main quote CTA card and contact method cards for phone, email, and visit.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Lists service offerings in a grid of cards with icons and descriptions plus additional contact info.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, plugins, and content paths for styling the project.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, deployment info, and tracked feature updates for the AutoFit Accessories site.
